parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of trigger. Valid values:

*   `deployment`: performs actions on Deployments.
*   `application`: performs actions on applications that are deployed in Application Center.

Default value: `deployment`.

If you do not set this parameter, triggers are not filtered by type.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description:
The action that the trigger performs. Set the value to redeploy.

`redeploy`: redeploys the resources specified by `project_id`.

If you do not specify this parameter, triggers are not filtered by action.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs get-kubernetes-trigger --cluster-id c5cdf7e3938bc4f8eb0e44b21a80f0000 --namespace default --type deployment --name web-server --action redeploy --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cs GET /triggers/c5cdf7e3938bc4f8eb0e44b21a80f0000 --region cn-hangzhou --Type deployment --action redeploy --Namespace default --Name 'web-server' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
